items.a: Test intelligence applies analytics and AI to test results to find flaky tests, group failures, explain root causes and show quality trends across builds.

items.q: How does TestMu AI detect flaky tests?
items.a: Test Insights compares results for the same test on the same code across runs and flags tests that switch between pass and fail.

items.q: What is AI root cause analysis for tests?
items.a: AI root cause analysis reads failure logs, groups related failures and suggests the likely cause with the evidence behind it.

items.q: Is test intelligence the same as test observability?
items.a: They overlap. Test observability is visibility into test runs; test intelligence adds analysis such as flakiness detection, clustering and root cause.

items.q: Do I need to change my tests?
items.a: No. Insights populate from runs on TestMu AI and HyperExecute.
